Alex K: Pushing a tiny starter that wires Redwood SDK + Next.js + LangChain types. Needs review — telemetry + auth/retry weirdness in CI.
Maria P: Nice. Can you repro the auth retry locally? Which SDK version?
Alex K: Using @redwood/inference-js 0.9.1-beta. On CI we see repeated 401 then backoff hits and opaque request body on retry. Logs show 'auth-middleware: token missing' after a 200 sometimes.
Jin: That sounds like token rotation race. Are you using the browser edge runtime or serverless API route?
Alex K: SSR API route (app/api/generate/route.ts). Token fetched from env via server components. Repro steps: 1) start dev server 2) run playwright tests 3) hit /api/generate concurrently 4) sometimes one request returns empty string and subsequent retry 401.
Tyler (devex): Could be our fetch wrapper not cloning Request properly before streaming. Alex, can you paste the route code? Also include headers you're forwarding.
Alex K: ```ts
export async function POST(req){
  const body = await req.json();
  const resp = await inference.generate({model:'gpt-redwood-1', input: body.prompt});
  return NextResponse.json({out: await resp.text()});
}
```
Maria P: Hmm looks like you're calling resp.text() — with streaming that might consume body and break retries.
Alex K: Good catch. I switched to readableStream piping — but then types broke in LangChain connector.
Jin: SDK parity issue: JS runtimes expect Response-like streaming; our LangChain helper expects a string. We should add a typed stream adapter in the sample app.
devex-bot: Reminder: file a small PR to devex/starter-templates with failing test + fix so CI tracks it :memo:
Alex K: Created PR 2345 with failing test and fix. Also added telemetry events: 'starter.eval.run' typed with {scenario:'playwright-concurrency', tokens: 'int'} — realized we didn't strongly type tokens in telemetry schema.
Tyler (devex): Let's avoid ad-hoc telemetry shapes. Devex, can we add a validator in SDK that enforces telemetry schema at compile time (TS) and runtime for JS? @Maria can you pair on this?
Maria P: Yep. I'll scope a small change to add zod schemas for telemetry events in the SDK and update starter to import them.
Jin: Also adding a LangChain adapter in the sample that exposes .stream() vs .text() and a small unit test.
Alex K: Thanks — tests passing locally. Deploying a canary of the starter to staging to validate CI flakes.
Tyler (devex): Sweet. For the PR description please add reproduction steps and the specific CI job id where flakiness showed (job/687). :thumbsup:
Alex K: Will do. Thanks all.
